High-level asks (please reply with ownership by EOD PST):
- Final hero + 2 CTA variants for invite email (Marissa) — include co-host copy for CloudBox.
- Seed lists: confirm priority seed segments and suppression (Ben) — attached is the draft seed_list_segment.xlsx.
- Tracking plan: map HubSpot UTMs and redirect tracking for partner link (Karthik).
- Gating: propose a gating rule (e.g., first 48 hours: only seed + SSO customers, then open to general list).
- QA: staging RSVP link + test payloads (Jordan) — I will spin a staging page and post test links.

Notes: please avoid adding additional paid channels until we validate conversion on the seed. CloudBox needs co-host copy and their logo. I copied external contact for visibility later.

Quick tracking + seed notes — owning the segment work.

Tracking plan (proposed):
- HubSpot campaign: HS-23871 (use for all seed + nurture flows)
- UTM pattern: utm_source=email&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=HS-23871&utm_content={cta_variant}&utm_partner=cloudbox
- Partner redirect: /r/cloudbox?rid={partner_id}&hs_tid=HS-23871 (ensures we can attribute partials)
- RSVP landing test: add param test=true to verify server-side gating flag.

Seed segmentation (from attached):
- Priority seed A (enterprise + existing DC customers): 1,200 contacts — 48hr priority window.
- Seed B (eng newsletter warm list): 8,000 contacts — cadence starts at T+48h.
- Suppress: opt-outs, bounced, and customers in active POCs.

I'll update the sheet and push to the shared Drive. Adding acme_cohost_logo.svg for CloudBox placement.
